出生地: 美国,佛罗里达州,迈尔斯堡
简介: Halley Gross received her undergraduate degree from The Gallatin School at New York University, with a concentration in comedy writing and a master's degree in dramatic writing from The Tisch School of the Arts, also at New York University, concentrating in writing for television. She lives in Los Angeles, writing for film/tv/games.
